# TonWalletGaslessTransfersInfoHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.TonWalletGaslessTransfersInfoHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The TonWalletGaslessTransfersInfo handler class. Used to handle changes of the gasless transfers available
to the TON wallet of the current user. It is intended to be used with
[`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_ton_wallet_gasless_transfers_info`](../decorators/on_ton_wallet_gasless_transfers_info.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when the gasless transfers info of the TON wallet changes. It
  takes *(client, ton_wallet_gasless_transfers_info)* as positional arguments (look at the section
  below for a detailed description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the handler.

    ton_wallet_gasless_transfers_info ([`TonWalletGaslessTransfersInfo`](../types/wallet/TonWalletGaslessTransfersInfo.md)):
        The new gasless transfers info.
